name: Button: Send Email Message
purpose: Sends the current email message: asks once per session for the user's SMTP password (unless the system settings are used), commits, calls "Send Email Message Activity { json }" in karbon_kontroller with the message id and user id, handles an authentication failure (error 1507) by clearing the stored password and offering a retry (calls itself), shows an error dialog on other failures, and closes the window on success.

karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/775 "Button: Send Email Message" (step 24)
external: Perform Script Send Email Message Activity { json } (karbon_kontroller scripts/521, step 15): sends the mail through SMTP using the user's password or system settings
open_question: secret: step 5 collects the user's SMTP password into User::SmtpPassword#118 (a global field, held in memory for the session; the file-close trigger karbon_data script 3 also clears it) and script 521 uses it to authenticate; the target must keep it in a managed secret store, not in a normal field. The script calls itself on retry (step 24), unbounded as long as the user chooses Try Again. $ActivityId and $Sent (steps 32-33) are set but not used. The actual SMTP send is in karbon_kontroller script 521.
